Product Description: A G-spot vibrator that earns its curve. Six rumbly intensities (not the high-pitched buzz of cheap dupes), three patterns, and a bulb that hits the right spot without you having to angle-search for ten minutes. Body-safe silicone with a satin finish that warms quickly and stays grippy when wet. Whisper-quiet through three settings, surprisingly purr-y on the top. Magnetic USB-C charging, ~85 minutes per charge, IPX7 fully waterproof. Travel lock built in. Comes in dusty rose or deep forest.

The full-size wand I tell people to splurge on if they're going to splurge on one toy. Eight intensities and six patterns of genuinely deep, rumbly power — the kind that doesn't go numb after two minutes. Flexible neck so the head pivots to where you actually need it, not just straight on. Heated head option (gentle, not gimmicky). Cordless with a 110-minute runtime, plus an included USB-C cable that doubles as a wall plug. Body-safe silicone head, IPX6 splash-proof (rinse-clean, not bath-safe). Heavier than a bullet but balances well in the hand.

The water-based companion to our silicone pick — same clean ingredient list, different use case. Four ingredients, no glycerin, no parabens, no fragrance. Slick without being thick, wipes clean with water, won't stain sheets. Safe with every toy material including silicone (the silicone version is not). pH-balanced for daily use, dermatologist-tested, vegan. 4 oz pump bottle, made in small batches in California. Reapplies cleanly without that tacky pull most water-based lubes have at the 20-minute mark.
